commands.summary: Interactive or topic help from this catalog
Offline toolchain diagnosis with repair commands
Explain a runtime or package from the offline catalog
Choose software architecture using deterministic questions
Choose an execution runtime from explicit goals
Scaffold a new AgentSam project from a preset
Inspect and verify governed plugin products
Create, inspect, and install a specific skill
Manage the local agentsamd runtime and daemon
Manage terminal identity and enrollment, distinct from PTY sessions
Run this project’s npm dev script
Machine inspection, evidence crawl, and read-only code reuse proposals
Discover, audit, benchmark, and govern local AI engines
Audit, verify, and plan publication of distributable packages
Preflight designs against portable manufacturing profiles
Inspect receipt proofs and prune ephemeral AgentSam workdirs
List or load portable skill instructions
Git + bridge context from any repo
Account, models, terminal, and live deploy awareness
Inspect lifecycle hooks, sources, and execution receipts
Audit credentials, drift, and failure remediation (never prints secrets)
Sign in and persist machine-local session
Google Cloud auth, projects, compute, IAM SAs, billing, doctor
Rust/Wasm scaffold, doctor, check, build, dev, explicit deploy
MCP server catalog and client adapters
Context fixtures and live eval telemetry
Guided codebase ingest: materials, allowlist, embeddings, storage
Durable project-local work plans + domain plans
Inspect and control AgentSam runs across local or hosted control planes

capabilities.description: Read-only native deterministic repository inspection in the authorized workspace; only advertised when a Machine runtime is resolved.
Run a named npm test script in the authorized workspace after execution approval.
Read a bounded UTF-8 file from the selected project workspace without escaping its root.
Write a bounded UTF-8 file in the selected workspace; updating existing files requires expected_sha256 and host approval.
Search AgentSam registered commands, packages, and executable capability declarations.
Describe a named AgentSam capability, CLI command or package without implying it is runnable.
Report capability handler binding and availability; never infer a working runtime from a declaration.
Invoke one of the allowlisted AgentSam operations through the host-authorized registry, with a structured result.
Collect a read-only, content-addressed repository evidence snapshot.
Analyze a certified repository snapshot through an injected reasoning adapter without granting mutation authority.
Observe repository composition, manifests, churn, pressure, and stability.
Build the SDK local/portable coherent incremental structural/text generation with optional embeddings.
Retrieve bounded repository context from the SDK local/portable published knowledge generation.
Create a portable SHA-256 filesystem snapshot.
Capture and finalize content-addressed deployment evidence.
Scan dependency vulnerability evidence and Merkle-bound AST execution trust boundaries; return deterministic contradiction and repair evidence.
Deterministically extract brand/visual evidence from the same repository.snapshot file authority (colors, tokens, components, assets).
Cluster observed brand evidence into inferred roles with confidence; never mutates the repository.
Produce a preserve→normalize→migrate brand coherence plan; optional --goap sequencing.
Generate portable identity/auth application surfaces from SDK contracts.
Create a local-first project from a deterministic preset selection.
Convert explicit evidence slices into bounded worker task packets.
Project-scoped public website crawling, verified page/image evidence, Knowledge indexing handoff, and explicit project-owned R2 storage.
Discover an already-installed native Blender runtime and report its executable and version.
Inspect a Blender scene headlessly without saving or mutating the source file.
Create or modify Blender geometry through a bounded declarative modeling recipe without arbitrary Python execution.
Render a bounded preview from an existing Blender scene and return a content hash receipt.
Export selected Blender scene content to GLB, STL, or OBJ with versioned SHA-256 artifact evidence.
Discover compact capability cards without injecting the full tool catalog or full schemas.
Select bounded evidence against an explicit model-aware context budget and return a measurable receipt.
Run a real argv-safe CLI process inside the runtime-owned project, with bounded output, credential-stripped environment, and explicit execution approval.
Execute one allowlisted read-only Wrangler operation with argv-safe cwd/config scoping and structured diagnostics.
Summarize a local workerd/DevTools CPU profile into bounded ranked self-time evidence.
Analyze a bounded Cloudflare CPU profile and selected source evidence through an injected reasoning adapter without deploy authority.

Core work-graph primitive (WorkItem, Dependency, TimelineEvent, Artifact, Evidence, Actor) that engineering and business adapters and timeline/Gantt renderers project onto. The graph is the source of truth; the timeline UI is a view over it, not its own state.
Maps supplied git commits to work items without network access.
Maps supplied MCP tool call receipts to work items without network access.
Maps supplied project records to work items without network access.
Renders a work graph into a timeline model (lanes by actor, work items per lane, timeline events) for a Gantt-style view. Pure projection — never a data source.
Projects work items to a Gantt model; a reference HTML prototype is included separately.
Resolve the stock AgentSam CMS storefront shell theme contract.
Normalize existing Rust Machine evidence into deterministic repository resources and edges.
Find evidence-based code-reuse proposals; no source modification or promotion.
